title: षष्ट्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 160 · The Pandavas' replies to Duryodhana

summary.en: Bhima, his eyes red with anger, sends word that he will fulfil his vows, kill Duryodhana and drink Duhshasana's blood; Nakula, Sahadeva, Virata, Drupada and Dhrishtadyumna add their own challenges. Uluka returns to Duryodhana, and Karna orders the Kaurava army to march.
summary.kn: ಕೋಪದಿಂದ ಕೆಂಪಾದ ಕಣ್ಣುಗಳ ಭೀಮನು ಪ್ರತಿಜ್ಞೆ ನೆರವೇರಿಸಿ ದುರ್ಯೋಧನನನ್ನು ಕೊಂದು ದುಃಶಾಸನನ ರಕ್ತ ಕುಡಿಯುವೆನೆಂದು ಹೇಳಿ ಕಳುಹಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ನಕುಲ, ಸಹದೇವ, ವಿರಾಟ, ದ್ರುಪದ, ಧೃಷ್ಟದ್ಯುಮ್ನರೂ ತಮ್ಮ ಸವಾಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಉಲೂಕನು ದುರ್ಯೋಧನನ ಬಳಿ ಮರಳುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಕರ್ಣನು ಕೌರವಸೈನ್ಯವನ್ನು ಹೊರಡಲು ಆಜ್ಞಾಪಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: क्रोध से लाल आँखों वाले भीम सन्देश भेजते हैं कि वे अपनी प्रतिज्ञाएँ पूरी करेंगे, दुर्योधन को मारेंगे और दुःशासन का रक्त पिएँगे; नकुल, सहदेव, विराट, द्रुपद और धृष्टद्युम्न भी अपनी चुनौतियाँ जोड़ते हैं। उलूक दुर्योधन के पास लौटता है, और कर्ण कौरव सेना को कूच का आदेश देता है।
summary.te: కోపంతో ఎర్రబడిన కళ్లతో భీముడు తన ప్రతిజ్ఞలు నెరవేర్చి దుర్యోధనుని చంపి దుఃశాసనుని రక్తం తాగుతానని కబురు పంపుతాడు; నకులుడు, సహదేవుడు, విరాటుడు, ద్రుపదుడు, ధృష్టద్యుమ్నుడు కూడా తమ సవాళ్లను జోడిస్తారు. ఉలూకుడు దుర్యోధనుని దగ్గరకు తిరిగివెళ్తాడు, కర్ణుడు కౌరవసైన్యాన్ని కదలమని ఆజ్ఞాపిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: சினத்தால் சிவந்த கண்களுடன் பீமன் தன் சபதங்களை நிறைவேற்றித் துரியோதனனைக் கொன்று துச்சாதனனின் இரத்தத்தைக் குடிப்பேன் என்று செய்தி அனுப்ப, நகுலன், ஸஹதேவன், விராடன், த்ருபதன், த்ருஷ்டத்யும்னன் தம் அறைகூவல்களைச் சேர்க்கிறார்கள். உலூகன் துரியோதனனிடம் திரும்ப, கர்ணன் கௌரவப் படையைப் புறப்படுமாறு ஆணையிடுகிறான்.
summary.ml: കോപംകൊണ്ട് കണ്ണു ചുവന്ന ഭീമൻ, തന്റെ പ്രതിജ്ഞ നിറവേറ്റി ദുര്യോധനനെ കൊല്ലുമെന്നും, ദുശ്ശാസനന്റെ രക്തം കുടിക്കുമെന്നും സന്ദേശമയയ്ക്കുന്നു; നകുലൻ, സഹദേവൻ, വിരാടൻ, ദ്രുപദൻ, ധൃഷ്ടദ്യുമ്നൻ എന്നിവരും തങ്ങളുടെ വെല്ലുവിളികൾ ചേർക്കുന്നു. ഉലൂകൻ ദുര്യോധനന്റെ അടുത്തേക്ക് മടങ്ങുന്നു; കർണ്ണൻ കൗരവസേനയോട് മുന്നേറാൻ കൽപ്പിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 5.160; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jan 23 2024

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
दुर्योधनस्य तद्वाक्यं निशम्य भरतर्षभः ।
नेत्राभ्यामतिताम्राभ्यां कैतव्यं समुदैक्षत ॥

meaning.en: Hearing Duryodhana's words, the best of Bharatas looked at the son of Kitava with eyes deep red.

verses.text:
स केशवमभिप्रेक्ष्य गुडाकेशो महायशाः ।
अभ्यभाषत कैतव्यं प्रगृह्य विपुलं भुजम् ॥

meaning.en: Gudakesha, of great fame, looked at Keshava, and raising his mighty arm, spoke to the son of Kitava.

verses.text:
स्ववीर्यं यः समाश्रित्य समाह्वयति वै परान् ।
अभीतः पूरयञ्शक्तिं स वै पुरुष उच्यते ॥

meaning.en: He who calls out his foes relying on his own strength, fearless and giving his full power, is truly called a man.

verses.text:
परवीर्यं समाश्रित्य यः समाह्वयते परान् ।
क्षत्रबन्धुरशक्तत्वाल्लोके स पुरुषाधमः ॥

meaning.en: But a Kshatriya-in-name who challenges others relying on others' strength, being weak, is the lowest of men in the world.

verses.text:
स त्वं परेषां वीर्येण मन्यसे वीर्यमात्मनः ।
स्वयं कापुरुषो मूढः परांश्च क्षेप्तुमिच्छसि ॥

meaning.en: You judge your own strength by the strength of others; being a coward and a fool yourself, you want to taunt others.

verses.text:
यस्त्वं वृद्धं सर्वराज्ञां हितबुद्धिं जितेन्द्रियम् ।
मरणाय महाबुद्धिं दीक्षयित्वा विकत्थसे ॥

meaning.en: You who, after consecrating the aged, wise, self-controlled Bhishma, well-wisher of all kings, for his death, now boast.

verses.text:
भावस्ते विदितोऽस्माभिर्दुर्बुद्धे कुलपांसन ।
न हनिष्यन्ति गाङ्गेयं पाण्डवा घृणयेति च ॥

meaning.en: Wicked-minded disgrace of your family, we understand your thought: that the Pandavas will not kill Ganga's son out of pity.

verses.text:
यस्य वीर्यं समाश्रित्य धार्तराष्ट्र विकत्थसे ।
हन्तास्मि प्रथमं भीष्मं मिषतां सर्वधन्विनाम् ॥

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra's son, you boast relying on his strength, saying, "I will kill Bhishma first before all the archers' eyes."

verses.text:
कैतव्य गत्वा भरतान्समेत्य
सुयोधनं धार्तराष्ट्रं ब्रवीहि ।
तथेत्याह अर्जुनः सव्यसाची
निशाव्यपाये भविता विमर्दः ॥

meaning.en: Son of Kitava, go to the Bharatas and tell Suyodhana, son of Dhritarashtra: Arjuna, the left-handed archer, said "So be it"; the clash will come when night ends.

verses.text:
यद्वोऽब्रवीद्वाक्यमदीनसत्त्वो
मध्ये कुरूणां हर्षयन्सत्यसंधः ।
अहं हन्ता पाण्डवानामनीकं
शाल्वेयकांश्चेति ममैष भारः ॥

meaning.en: What he said, of undaunted spirit and true to his word, gladdening the Kurus: "I shall kill the Pandavas' army and the Shalveyakas; this burden is mine."

verses.text:
हन्यामहं द्रोणमृते हि लोकं
न ते भयं विद्यते पाण्डवेभ्यः ।
ततो हि ते लब्धतमं च राज्यं
क्षयं गताः पाण्डवाश्चेति भावः ॥

meaning.en: "Apart from Drona I could slay the world; you need not fear the Pandavas; thus your kingdom is won and the Pandavas are as good as ruined" - that is your thought.

verses.text:
स दर्पपूर्णो न समीक्षसे त्व-
मनर्थमात्मन्यपि वर्तमानम् ।
तस्मादहं ते प्रथमं समूहे
हन्ता समक्षं कुरुवृद्धमेव ॥

meaning.en: Full of pride, you do not see the ruin that stands in yourself; therefore I will first kill the aged Kuru, Bhishma, before all in the crowd.

verses.text:
सूर्योदये युक्तसेनः प्रतीक्ष्य
ध्वजी रथी रक्ष च सत्यसंधम् ।
अहं हि वः पश्यतां द्वीपमेनं
रथाद्भीष्मं पातयितास्मि बाणैः ॥

meaning.en: At sunrise, with your army ready, wait with banner and chariot, and guard the truthful one; for in your sight I shall fell Bhishma from his chariot with arrows, as he stands like an island.

verses.text:
श्वोभूते कत्थनावाक्यं विज्ञास्यति सुयोधनः ।
अर्दितं शरजालेन मया दृष्ट्वा पितामहम् ॥

meaning.en: Tomorrow Suyodhana will know the meaning of that boasting when he sees the grandfather pierced by my net of arrows.

verses.text:
यदुक्तश्च सभामध्ये पुरुषो ह्रस्वदर्शनः ।
क्रुद्धेन भीमसेनेन भ्राता दुःशासनस्तव ॥

meaning.en: And what angry Bhimasena said in the middle of the assembly of your brother Duhshasana, the short-sighted man,

verses.text:
अधर्मज्ञो नित्यवैरी पापबुद्धिर्नृशंसकृत् ।
सत्यां प्रतिज्ञां नचिराद्रक्ष्यसे तां सुयोधन ॥

meaning.en: Ignorant of dharma, always hostile, wicked-minded and cruel: you, Suyodhana, will soon see that vow made true.

verses.text:
अभिमानस्य दर्पस्य क्रोधपारुष्ययोस्तथा ।
नैष्ठुर्यस्यावलेपस्य आत्मसंभावनस्य च ॥

meaning.en: Of conceit, pride, anger and harshness, of cruelty and arrogance and self-regard,

verses.text:
नृशंसतायास्तैक्ष्ण्यस्य धर्मविद्वेषणस्य च ।
अधर्मस्यातिवादस्य वृद्धातिक्रमणस्य च ॥

meaning.en: Of brutality, sharpness, hatred of dharma, adharma, abusive speech and disrespect of elders,

verses.text:
दर्शनस्य च वक्रस्य कृत्स्नस्यापनयस्य च ।
द्रक्ष्यसि त्वं फलं तीव्रमचिरेण सुयोधन ॥

meaning.en: Of the crooked eye and every wrong policy, you will soon see the bitter fruit, Suyodhana.

verses.text:
वासुदेवद्वितीये हि मयि क्रुद्धे नराधिप ।
आशा ते जीविते मूढ राज्ये वा केन हेतुना ॥

meaning.en: For when I am angry, with Vasudeva as my second, king, what hope have you of life or kingdom, fool?

verses.text:
शान्ते भीष्मे तथा द्रोणे सूतपुत्रे च पातिते ।
निराशो जीविते राज्ये पुत्रेषु च भविष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: When Bhishma, Drona and the charioteer's son have been laid low, you will be without hope for life, kingdom and sons.

verses.text:
भ्रातॄणां निधनं दृष्ट्वा पुत्राणां च सुयोधन ।
भीमसेनेन निहतो दुष्कृतानि स्मरिष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the deaths of your brothers and sons, Suyodhana, and killed by Bhimasena, you will remember your evil deeds.

verses.text:
न द्वितीयां प्रतिज्ञां हि प्रतिज्ञास्यति केशवः ।
सत्यं ब्रवीम्यहं ह्येतत्सर्वं सत्यं भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: Keshava does not make a second promise; I tell you the truth, and all this will come true.

verses.text:
इत्युक्तः कैतवो राजंस्तद्वाक्यमुपधार्य च ।
अनुज्ञातो निववृते पुनरेव यथागतम् ॥

meaning.en: So addressed, the son of Kitava, O king, took in those words and, given leave, turned back as he had come.

verses.text:
उपावृत्य तु पाण्डुभ्यः कैतव्यो धृतराष्ट्रजम् ।
गत्वा यथोक्तं तत्सर्वमुवाच कुरुसंसदि ॥

meaning.en: Returning from the Pandavas, the son of Kitava went to Dhritarashtra's son and told in the Kuru assembly all that had been said.

verses.text:
केशवार्जुनयोर्वाक्यं निशम्य भरतर्षभः ।
दुःशासनं च कर्णं च शकुनिं चाभ्यभाषत ॥

meaning.en: Hearing the words of Keshava and Arjuna, the best of Bharatas spoke to Duhshasana, Karna and Shakuni.

verses.text:
आज्ञापयत राज्ञश्च बलं मित्रबलं तथा ।
यथा प्रागुदयात्सर्वा युक्ता तिष्ठत्यनीकिनी ॥

meaning.en: Command the king's forces and the allies' forces so that the whole army stands ready before sunrise.

verses.text:
ततः कर्णसमादिष्टा दूताः प्रत्वरिता रथैः ।
उष्ट्रवामीभिरप्यन्ये सदश्वैश्च महाजवैः ॥

meaning.en: Then, at Karna's order, messengers hurried off, some in chariots, others on camel-drawn carts and on fine, very swift horses.

verses.text:
तूर्णं परिययुः सेनां कृत्स्नां कर्णस्य शासनात् ।
आज्ञापयन्तो राज्ञस्तान्योगः प्रागुदयादिति ॥

meaning.en: They quickly went round the whole army on Karna's command, ordering them on the king's behalf: be ready before sunrise.
